name: SESEN BIO INC.
summary: Sesen Bio, Inc. (now Carisma Therapeutics) is a late-stage clinical biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and commercialization of targeted fusion protein therapeutics for the treatment of cancer. The company uses its Targeted Protein Therapeutics platform to develop antibody-drug conjugates for the treatment of solid tumors. The company is headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.
